about: Dated notes shown on the Briefs screen. A brief is added only when the owner says so, never automatically with an update. Each brief: id (unique, never reused), date (YYYY-MM-DD), title, body (a blank line starts a new paragraph). Newest date first; adding one makes the 'N new briefs' box appear for everyone who has not seen it.

briefs.title: Pin on a globe or a flat map
briefs.body:
You can now drop your pin on a spinning globe instead of the flat map. Tap a region to zoom in, then tap again to place your pin.

Pick the one you like in Settings. Your choice is saved on this device.
